notes.title: Fearful Injection - The Game Over Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes

- added new cursors to the PC interface for more immersion
- added a more fancy game over screen including animation & sound
- adjusted the difficulty increase in the late game
- improved some of the ending game logic

Have fun,

Tom

notes.title: Fearful Injection - Balancing & Code Improvement!
notes.content:
Patch Notes

- improved the PC animation code
- reduces the sizes of some cursor variants
- improved the progressive difficulty curve as gameplay duration increases

Have fun,

Tom

notes.title: Hotfix #03
notes.content: Sorry for the update spam. I needed to hotfix some of the code.

notes.title: Hotfix #02
notes.content: Fixed an issue that caued code to execute in the wrong order leading to a possible softlock

notes.title: Fearful Injection - PC Animations & Quality Of Life Improvements!
notes.content:
Patch Notes

- the indicator to grab the crucifix will now show correctly so that players know they can reach it on the ground
- improved many scripts to be more performant
- added an animation when entering and exiting the PC

Have fun,

Tom

notes.title: Fearful Injection - UI Navigation
notes.content:
Patch Notes

- players can now interact with the radio (and maybe find a secret)
- sub-menus can now all be exited with the escape key
- fixed an issue that prevented the pause menu to be closed with the escape key
- added text showing the controls for when the player is holding an item

Have fun,

Tom

notes.title: Fearful Injection - Radio & Slow Start Skip!
notes.content:
Patch Notes

- added a radio (you'll know what it does when you play the game)
- fixed the player controller in the ending, should now work properly
- added a small time buffer to the anomaly spawning for when the player resets the system successfully
- added the option to skip the initial observation time at the beginning of the game for experienced players
- fixed an issue that allowed the game to initialize multiple steam managers

Have fun,

Tom

notes.title: Fearful Injection - The Breaker Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes

- added a risky breaker minigame to encourage the player to not let the system temperature drop to 0
- replaced a missing material that made some miscellaneous objects invisible
- rewrote the tutorial once more and added two new tabs to it

Have fun,

Tom

notes.title: Fearful Injection - Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed an issue that would mess up the code in the game ending scene

notes.title: Fearful Injection - More fixes & phone call cancelling!
notes.content:
Patch Notes

- fixed some spelling in the beginning story text
- the player now can skip calls by pressing "e" on the phone again
- fixed a certain ghost interaction
- fixed some ghost timings
- adjusted some text for more clarity
- some more bug fixes
- fixed an issue that caused footsteps to play even if the player wasn't moving

Have fun,

Tom

notes.title: Fearful Injection - Hotfix
notes.content:
